decision_rule: OFFLINE SEALED-POOL CONFIRMATION READ (VER-1b; owner decision 257, decision 258 option A proposed 2026-10-10; claim ceiling 'descriptive' for the pool; the pool cell claims NO benefit). One flight, one Perception visit and one grouped Solver visit per row of TRAIN Fold A: sample 0 greedy, samples 1-2 at temperature 0.7, all over the SAME state and evidence, committed in flight by saea-commit-plurality-support-v1 at min_support 2. THE FIXED RULE (fixed on SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2 by the VER-1a pool read, docs/readiness/2026-10-10-slurp-ver1a-samples-fold-b-v1; NOT re-tuned on this roster): the support filter over the first n = 3 samples at s = 2 (an entity is kept iff supported by >= 2 of the 3 samples; same type, normalised-filler character F1 >= 0.8), the base answer = sample 0 (the greedy sample) with its own labels, the c3 presence verdict (cell VER-1c's r1-c3 column answered no entity after the registered v4g normaliser) gated by the pre-Solver signature N1 >= theta = 0.2, delivered through the lock's v4g normaliser. THE READS, all from sealed bytes, model-free: (1) CUSTODY (row accounting): 1,080 in, 1,080 out; every row's solver_group carries exactly 3 samples in custody (invariant I7g) with temperatures 0, 0.7, 0.7 and the pinned seeds fragment_seed + 0 + index; the replay of the commit reproduces the sealed delivered text on every row; zero tool calls. (2) PER-SAMPLE scores: each custodied raw sample rendered to one outputs COPY (scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage render, 3 samples auto-detected) and scored ONCE with the registered scorer, both as sealed (unprojected) and through the lock's delivery rule v4g applied OFFLINE (scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_postproc_v4_apply.py --apply v4g; the in-flight cell delivers the unnormalised commit because the loader refuses a deliver_normaliser beside a grouped visit); sample 0 is read against the VER-1c lock column on the same rows as the byte-identity audit of the greedy first sample (llama.cpp greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch shapes, so equality is measured, not assumed). (3) THE CONFIRMATION: the fixed rule applied to the sealed pool and the VER-1c c3 column by the offline composer (python -B scripts/analysis/slurp_ver1_offline.py --mode read --run-id SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VER1B-SAMPLES-FOLD-A-V1 --attempt attempt-slurp-native-stage3-ver1b-samples-fold-a-generation-v1 --split train --rows 1080 --n 3 --s 2 --thetas 0.2 --verdict-run SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VER1C-C3-COLUMN-FOLD-A-V1:attempt-slurp-native-stage3-ver1c-c3-column-fold-a-generation-v1:r1-c3 --label VER1B-FOLD-A-V1 --sealed-scorer slurp-slu-official-train); reported with the whole-utterance paired bootstrap CI95 (10,000 draws, seed 20260915) against the lock column of VER-1c (the delivering arm, request-identical to today's delivery), against the pool's own sample 0 and against the sealed delivered commit (re-scored), pooled SLU-F1 and intent, false fills removed, non-empty exact rows lost / gained, per-scenario natural and equal-stratum tables. CRITERION, on file BEFORE the flight (owner decision 258 may only tighten it): the rule is CONFIRMED iff its pooled SLU-F1 delta against the VER-1c lock column is at or above the 0.67 pp offline sealed-pool floor of the instrument note (section 2d) AND its CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the intent moves by no more than the 0.67 pp floor; anything else is reported as NOT CONFIRMED with the numbers, never softened. NOTHING IS TUNED OR SELECTED HERE: n, s and theta are the fixed rule's; the read roster is SLURP-EVO-FOLD-A-V2, the tuning roster SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2; a confirmed rule is admitted, if at all, by the owner under its own registration.
